newsitem.title: USA: Senate economic emergency rule on budget.
newsitem.headline: Senate economic emergency rule on budget.

text.p: The Senate Monday defeated a proposal to suspend the balanced budget requirement during times of economic emergency such as a recession or natural disaster.

The amendment offered by Democratic freshman Sen. Richard Durbin of Illinois was tabled on a vote of 64-35, effectively preventing its passage. Durbin proposed this change to the Republicans' proposed balanced budget constitutional amendment, which requires the budget be balanced during peacetime. Senate debate on the constitutional amendment is to continue several weeks and the outcome is uncertain.
